dialogue.line: That's why you wanted a divorce...
'cause it would be easier for you to cut and run,
instead of trying to put our family back together!
you should shut the fuck up and listen.
how tight you're holding on to everything,
you're doing it because you're scared.
Ever since I woke up, something has been happening to me.
You're at a threshold. The hero has to be brave.
It was the boy in white.
He was the one that was telling secrets to Christopher.
Christopher wouldn't go to the tree, so...
I told my mother what the Boy in White said.
I can save all of you.
Is this really where it happens?
She was trying to help me.
There is either something horrible growing inside of her
or else this place has finally broken her mind.
But if you are not gonna tell everyone, then I am.
I'm gonna leave supplies for you at the shack twice a week.
It's the only place that the baby will be safe.
No! No, no! No! No, no!
I'm not going back to town without her, Dad.
Listen, Ellis, she took the talisman.
So what? All right, she wouldn't just leave.
We don't know that. Maybe she...
Hey, listen to me. Listen to me.
Look, we can come back out in the morning, okay?
No, I'm not leaving her out here overnight.
What are you gonna do, huh? You just gonna... You just...
Nothing. Let's just, uh... Let's just, uh...
to help you get a little more comfortable.
You're not a prisoner here. I told you,
this is for your own good.
Elgin, listen to me. I saw her.
That thing that's been speaking to you, I saw her.
This thing inside me, it's not good.
It won't do good things. Look at what happened to Tillie.
That happened because the baby was scared.
You know, you weren't feeding it.
Fatima, you have to stop fighting.
Hey, hey, hey. You know, wait, wait, wait.
Just listen. Listen. It's okay. It's okay.
The sooner you eat, the stronger the baby will be,
and before you know it, we'll be going home.
The baby already helped us once.
The night I found out you were pregnant,
I remembered my dream, and that helped Boyd save the town.
You helped me so much since I first got here.
Come on. Just a little bit.
I don't... I don't want to talk anymore.
I understand this could be difficult for you.
But if what you remember can help us understand
No, it won't! I can't... I can't help you
'cause all I did is make things worse.
She never would've gone if I... if I hadn't...
I-I don't want to remember anymore!
No, I can't help you. I can't help anyone.
I don't... I don't... I don't know.
Hey, you need to... you need to get out to the clinic.
Something happened to Julie out in the woods.
Okay, and just look right here.
Well, I don't see any signs of trauma, so that's good.
See? Nothing to worry about, okay?
Now, Julie, can you walk me through again
Uh, we got to the ruins,
I walked inside, and then I blacked out.
I... I had a really weird dream.
Okay, well, I'd like to keep you overnight,
'Kay, we'll give you folks some space.
What were you and Ethan doing out there?
I went to the woods yesterday with Randall
and then, we got to the ruins...
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa. With...
You were out there with Randall?
Look, Dad, it's not like that.
No. I passed out a little.
Something I can do for you?
What were you and Julie doing out in the woods?
What did she say we were doing in the woods?
Look, if this is your version of the big bad dad routine,
I'm not in the fucking mood, all right?
After what happened with you and Marielle and Julie...
And I know she's going through something that...
I cannot understand, but I figured you might.
I was teaching her how to drive, man.
her learner's permit, so we boosted the Colony House van.
freaked out about something and we ended up in the woods.
And the ruins that you saw?
Look, man, I don't mean to be a dick,
but I got my own shit going on, all right?
You want me to explain what happened to us? Well, I can't.
And I don't know about those fucking ruins,
but I told her not to go back out there.
Go get the van and teach your kid how to drive,
because there is fuck all you can do about the rest.
None of us are getting out of here alive.
All right, we need to get you to the clinic.
Okay. All right. Dad, you can barely walk.
All right? You're not fine. Whatever's going on with you...
Look, I know what's going on with me! I...
Yeah, I've known for a while.
Wherever she is, wherever she went, she's safe.
Sit down. We need to talk.
to celebrate a very special anniversary.
our dear sweet Fatima came into our lives.
Some of you were here then.
But all of you have come to know her and to love her,
for her kindness, for her strength,
The green thumb is definitely a big plus.
Our greenhouse never smelled so good.
you've made this big old drafty box
feel a little bit more like home.
I could have stayed with Julie.
We should've have taken Ethan back to the house.
And miss all the fun? Come on.
I haven't been doing a very good job.
I know you're trying to make sense of this place
And if there's even a chance that it could lead us home,
No more second-guessing, no more pushing back.
There's something Julie's not telling us.
It started just before I went out into the woods with Sara.
Look, I didn't want to worry you.
something else I need to tell you.
Uh, when I was in the barn with Tian-Chen...
The whole thing was a set-up to...
They said they wanted to break me.
What if this thing with Fatima, with the baby...
No, Dad, this isn't... this isn't because of you.
But you don't know that. You don't.
We don't know a fucking thing,
and Fatima is out there somewhere, and...
and I'm sitting here like a fucking gimp.
You doing okay in there, Boyd?
You shut your fucking mouth. Shut your fucking mouth!
Hey, come on, Dad, just... Oh, you want... fuck!
Get away from the fucking window.
All right, all right. All right.
No! No, no, no, no, no!
No, stop it! Stop it! Stop it!
I told you when you started to eat, things would go faster.
The baby's gonna be here in no time.
You know, you should probably put this on.
Those aren't going to fit you soon.
I had to go to the main storage.
I didn't want to risk going into your room.
Can you help me get up?
No! No! Elgin! Stop! No! Elgin!
You can't go out there blind. She could be anywhere.
Well, I'm not gonna find her just staying here.
Okay, then, we get more people.
How? Donna is about to tell the entire town what Fatima did.
You really think that people are gonna be lining up to help
Okay, great. Let me know how that goes.
Sorry. I didn't mean to interrupt,
but I don't think this can wait.
What the fuck do you know about that?
No, what the fuck do you...
I heard the voices last night
for the first time since the ruins.
That Fatima didn't leave on her own, that something took her.
They want you to know that she's close.
they know you won't find her in time.
They want you to know you can't save her.
What the hell is he doing? Jesus Christ.
Victor? Victor! What are you doing?
I kept all these things because I thought they could help!
But all they do is hurt!
I want it gone! I want all of it gone!
just wait! Hold on a second. Victor!
I said, get out of my way!
Victor, what's going on? Hey! What...
Just... let me go, please. Please!
If you tell us what you need the axe for.
I'm gonna go chop down a tree.
I'm just gonna go back to the house.
No, come on. You need to eat something.
Nice to see the place up and running again.
Mm. I had a little help.
This guy helped a lot with the cleaning and the reorganizing.
You know, any time you wanna come and lend a hand,
I could always use a helper.
You know, Kenny was really supportive.
I think it was hard for him
to see this place empty all the time.
And after what happened to Tillie,
I think people need a place that feels normal.
Did they find who did it to her?
I'll get us a couple of plates.
Look, look, I know you're upset with me, okay,
because of what she means to people here...
I don't think people could take it.
I don't think I can take it.
I had her in that shed just outside of town.
Ellis and I went there last night and she was gone.
but we won't be able to save her before it's too late.
She said the voices were laughing.
Ring the bell. We'll call a meeting.
What? You don't like your food?
He thinks it's his fault, what happened to me.
Because I asked him what I should do,
if I should go inside the ruins or not.
I know it was stupid. I just...
one of those stories he always used to tell us,
and I was afraid, and I didn't know who else to ask.
And no offense, but this whole
I know what you're trying to do, but it's...
We're gonna need everyone to come outside a minute.
You guys go. I'll... I'll wait for Ethan.
What happened to Tillie, we know you're all scared.
But right now, we don't have them.
We called you all here because...
nobody's seen her since last night.
What we're asking for is a search party.
People to scour the town, every corner,
every crack, so we can bring her home.
Whatever took her, is that what killed Tillie?
Look, I don't have all the information on what happened.
All I know is that she's close by.
I know that because something here told us,
that wants us to know that she's alone, that she's afraid.
Something that thinks that we don't have what it takes
Now, look, I can't tell anybody what to do.
Right? But you see these here?
When I first got here, those things in the woods,
they would come out at night
and they would take whoever the fuck they wanted.
Everybody here was living day to day,
moment to moment, hour to hour.
We proved that this place couldn't break us.
Now it's trying to break us again.
So you can either lay down and die or...
We are taking our lives back!
and I am asking for your help to prove it again.
There's no shame in backing out.
How are we gonna do this?
We're all gonna go out there
in groups of two, and we're gonna cover
every inch of this place, okay?
Okay. Okay. Let's do it. Let's go.
I have to help. Fatima's my friend.
We'll cover more ground that way.
There are gonna be a lot of questions.
Best if one of us finds her.
We've got a better chance by splitting up. Okay?
We are going to find her.
Hey, you mind coming out there with me?
You need someone to search with?
Anything I can do to help.
I don't understand what we're doing out here.
No one's forcing you to help.
You wanna go back to Colony House...
Boyd said that something told you guys that she was out here.
Sara? The girl who murdered people.
in ways that are hard to understand.
So, you're just gonna take her word for it?
What if Sara killed Tillie and Fatima
and then just made up some bullshit
about Fatima being held captive in the woods somewhere?
Okay. So, then, why wouldn't this, uh, magical voice
just tell Sara where Fatima is?
Better yet, why not tell her who killed Tillie?
That's not the way it works, okay?
So, then, tell me how it fucking works.
You know something that you're not telling me.
I don't understand you people. I'm a good cop.
I can be an asset here, if you just...
If I what? If I walk you through the many different ways
this place will fuck with your head?
I don't have time for a goddamn tutorial, okay?
Fatima is out there. We need to find her
because of what she means to the people of this town.
Because of what she means to me.
If you want me to believe that you are good at your job,
I need you to trust me.
I need you to help me.
When this is over, we'll talk, okay?
Hey, so, you're up at Colony House now, huh?
I been meaning to come up there and look in on you.
You got bigger things to worry about right now.
Look, I realize, uh, you and me...
things are never gonna be the same again.
I lied to you about what Sara did,
about your Dad, and I know there's a part of you
Being in charge of this place,
it comes with a whole mess of decisions
you never really want to make.
But people live and die here
based on your ability to make those decisions.
What are you... What are you doing?
Yesterday my leg froze. I almost...
Look, I'm not saying it's today, okay?
Or tomorrow or a month from now,
but I got a clock ticking on me.
Yesterday, that clock started ticking a little faster.
So... I need to know that, when I'm gone...
I need to know that when I'm gone
or when I'm too goddamn feeble to do anything,
I need to know that you are gonna step up
It has to be you wearing this badge
and not some hothead like Acosta
or anybody else who might come through here.
I need to know that my family is in good hands.
if you're still looking for a deputy,
What the fuck do you want? Huh?
I haven't seen enough of you people?
it's not doing it for me anymore.
You okay? Who are you talking to?
Well... Well, let me rephrase that:
who did you think you were talking to?
Henry, I'm busy. All right? What do you want?
My wife made one of these in our yard.
I don't know, okay? I thought it might help.
Help figure out those numbers, you mean?
Is there something I can help you with?
Most of the town's out looking for that girl.
We had a whole meeting about it.
you wanna come help me look?
I was hoping we could talk
It's a bad tree. It does bad things.
Why... why won't you help us?
I think you need to learn for yourselves.
It's the only way you'll understand.
All those years, you looked the same.
'Cause I don't know what to do.
You tell me... You tell me how I can help them.
You're supposed to be my friend.
Please? Please help me. Just tell me what to do.
Where are you going? No, come back!
You know, when I was little, a friend of mine went missing.
We had the whole neighborhood out looking for him.
Grandma said not to worry, but I was so scared.
Turns out he's on a playground on the other side of town,
having the time of his life. Everyone was scared for nothing.
Is that what you think this is?
I think sometimes we think the worst
Okay, well, what we do know is that my wife is missing.
We're not looking for some fucking kid on a playground.
All right, I already lost my mom.
I can't go through that again.
You think she could be in there?
Well, you never know. Best to check everywhere.
Besides, I think this'll be a good place to talk.
Well, we had a bit of a close call not too long ago.
Doesn't look like Fatima's in here.
Last time you were in here, you were in pretty bad shape.
And all I remember thinking was, "It's my fault."
"I was the one who was driving."
"I was the one who didn't see the other car coming."
I just kept thinking we were gonna lose you,
right then and there, just like we lost Thomas.
And I never would have forgiven myself.
and you were doing the best you could.
when you told Julie to go into those ruins?
You were doing the best you could, right?
Things happen here, things we can't control.
This... this place wants us to blame ourselves.
It wants us to be scared.
You have to remember that we're all doing our best,
Because how we face those things, that's what matters.
or whose fault it was, but how we take care of each other
and how we always do our best, no matter what.
So, what do you say we keep looking, huh?
Dad, please, don't leave me alone here.
You were right. It's not him.
This is where we spent the night when we came out of the tunnels.
Is this how it's gonna be from now on?
One by one, people just disappear?
She was the first person who made it seem like this place
Oh, honey, we're gonna find her.
I don't think I was dreaming.
When I... when I blacked out in the ruins, I...
it was almost like I went somewhere.
Like, one second I'm in this weird chamber
and the three of us are there... me, Randall, and Marielle,
And then, there was this guy chained to a wall,
and then I'm in these tunnels,
and I heard you talking to Victor.
I tried to find you, but your voice,
it kept just getting further and further away.
And then I heard those children.
"What if I never make it back?"
"What if... What if I'm lost and no one ever finds me?"
You'll never, never be alone here.
It's one of them watching us.
She wants us to follow her.
Everything about who Victor is now,
I feel like I'm starting over with a whole different person.
Look, why are you talking to me about this?
I don't know, literally anybody else.
Tabitha's got her own kids to worry about.
And don't take this the wrong way,
but you remind me of him.
trying to make a block of wood tell a story,
and you're up on a ladder,
screaming at people who aren't there.
How would it be for you
if your dad showed up here and saw you like this?
What... what would you want him to say to you?
Well, for starters, I'd want to know
where the fuck he's been my whole life,
but that's, uh, that's... Listen, I...
You're trying to figure out how to fix him, right?
Victor is the product of what this place made him.
Victor has been surviving here for decades.
He's been shaped by this place. He's...
He's Tarzan, growing up in the jungle.
And you're the guy who comes along
and makes him feel like an asshole
'cause he doesn't know how to use a fork.
At least there I can pretend I'm being productive.
You know she brought me here?
She helped me out a lot since I first got here.
She's helped a lot of people.
I'm so sorry about what happened to your mom.
You're not going to lose Fatima.
It's not gonna come to that.
All right, I appreciate you being out here.
I have to tell you something.
When we were on the bus on our way here, I had a dream.
I feel like something has been trying to talk to me.
What if all of this is happening for a reason?
What if Fatima is out there right now,
This might be a good thing,
you know, the baby and everything.
Wait. How... Why would this have anything to do with the baby?
No, I'm just... trying to say that...
we don't have all the information yet,
I don't want you to be afraid. I really...
I think she's gonna be okay.
I don't know. They've never done this before.
Come on, come on, come on.
What do you want? What do you want from me?!
No, no, no! No, stay away from me.
Stay away from me. Stay away from me.
Stay away from me. No, no!
Hey. That's... that's the root cellar.
That's the one I stayed in
when Victor pushed me through the tree.
What are you doing here, Victor?
This is where she left us.
All those years I thought there was a reason,
I was the reason she died.
No, Victor. It wasn't your fault.
You were just a little boy.
Don't touch me! Don't touch me!
Please, how can I help you, Mom?
